name: 投稿者の返信を含むコメントシート
prompt:
Create a clean Japanese comments-sheet UI matching the native preview at exactly 390x604 proportions. Use the native preview as authority for localized copy and layout; use the original screenshot crop for sheet structure and the prior blue-link sample only as a hyperlink color cue.

At the top, show a short gray drag handle and centered dark title コメント. Below, reproduce exactly three comment rows as in the preview. Row 1: mint avatar 山, bold author 山田 はるか, gray time 1日前, dark comment とてもすてきです！見ていて元気が出ます。, gray outline heart with gray count 160, and the blue hyperlink action 返信する. Row 2 is indented: mint avatar 光, bold ライトハウス with green 投稿者 badge, dark comment みなさん、ありがとうございます！, gray outline heart/count 96, blue 返信する, a divider and blue hyperlink さらに18件の返信を見る. Row 3: mint avatar 山, bold 山田 はるか, gray time 1日前, the same exact comment とてもすてきです！見ていて元気が出ます。, gray outline heart/count 160, and blue 返信する.

All three 返信する labels and the one さらに18件の返信を見る label are hyperlinks and must be blue #1976D2 per the user’s explicit direction. Keep 投稿者 green; author names and comments dark; timestamps and counts gray. At the bottom, show exactly eight reactions in this order: ❤️, 🙌, 🔥, 👏, 💚, 😍, 😮, 🙄. Then show a mint circular あ avatar and a white outlined input capsule with gray placeholder コメントを追加. The placeholder is not a link. Do not add a send button or any extra text/icons.

Keep the second author reply indented as shown, preserve the compact spacing and white background, and match the 390x604 proportions. Render all Japanese text exactly, with no underlines required.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
